pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high-contrast boundaries; edges exhibit fine-grained serration at hair-resolution. Geometry transitions from smaller, sub-ovoid shapes on the ventral neck to larger, elongated trapezoidal and rhomboidal forms on the lateral shoulder and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnecting light-pigmented pathways with variable thickness ranging from approximately 15 to 40 pixels. Network maintains high topological continuity with frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency vertical serrated profile against the background, composed of stiff, upright hair follicles visible at the dorsal-most neck boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: A deep, vertical musculature fold or shadow is visible at the transition between the lower neck and the shoulder, creating a significant linear disruption in the visual continuity of the pelage patches.
